    tidymetr: tidy meta-analysis and evidence synthesis

    Source: R/tidymetr-package.R
    tidymetr-package.Rd

    tidymetr provides a pipe-friendly grammar for meta-analysis. Effect sizes are computed with meta_effect_size(), pooled with meta_pool(), explained with meta_regress(), meta_subgroup() and meta_multilevel(), compared across treatments with meta_network(), checked for small-study effects with meta_egger(), meta_begg(), meta_trimfill(), meta_pet_peese() and meta_failsafe(), and stress tested with meta_leave1out(), meta_cumulative() and meta_influence(). Every estimator is written in base R and validated against published reference results.

    Results are tibble subclasses that work with dplyr, broom style tidiers (tidy(), glance(), augment()) and ggplot2::autoplot(). The tidymodels integration includes recipes steps (step_meta_effect_size(), step_meta_precision(), step_meta_impute_sd()), rsample resampling schemes (meta_leave_study_out_cv(), meta_cluster_cv()), yardstick metrics (inverse_var_rmse(), coverage_prob(), heterogeneity_r2()) and a parsnip model specification (meta_linear()).
